latestVersion.changelog:
Motion Graphics Generator 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Transform text or images into animated graphics videos (up to 1080p MP4, 200MB/file).
- Marketer-friendly: generate intros, text overlays, branded video sequences in 30–90 seconds via cloud GPU.
- Supports batch, iterative, and quick-edit workflows.
- Easy setup: handles anonymous registration and session creation automatically.
- Exposes simple chat-based commands for upload, edit, export, credits, and status.
- Wide format support: PNG, JPG, SVG, MP4, MOV, AVI, GIF, MP3, WAV, more.
